landing.heroBody: Upload and manage your files from an intuitive dashboard — or integrate them via REST API. Simple for teams, powerful for developers.
landing.personasTitle: Simple for teams. Powerful for developers.
landing.persona1Desc: Manage all your assets from a clean interface. No command line, no configuration.
landing.persona1F2: Share files via a direct link
landing.persona2Desc: A complete API with SDKs, webhooks and S3 compatibility for seamless integration.
landing.persona3Desc: Launch fast without managing infrastructure. Pay only for what you use, scale without limits.
landing.manageTitle: Store, manage and serve your files — simply
landing.manageDesc: S3-compatible object storage for web apps, mobile apps, AI pipelines, e-commerce, media platforms, SaaS products and anything that needs reliable file storage.
landing.manageF1Desc: AWS SDK, boto3, and every S3 tool you already know.
landing.manageF2Desc: Upload from any language or runtime.
landing.manageF3Desc: Your files served from Cloudflare's edge, everywhere in the world.
landing.manageF4Desc: React to uploads, deletions and renames instantly.
landing.manageF5Desc: Private, secure links with configurable expiration.
landing.manageF6Desc: Manage your files without writing a single line of code.
landing.howStep1Body: Group your storage by project. Each workspace has its own folders, API keys and webhooks.
landing.howStep2Body: Organize your files into folders inside the workspace. Set each folder as public or private to control access.
landing.howStep3Body: Via the dashboard, the JS or Python SDK, or a plain curl. Live and served from the CDN in seconds.
landing.featTitle: Everything you need to store and serve files
landing.featSubtitle: Intuitive for teams, powerful for developers — no compromises.
landing.feat1Body: Organize files into buckets, group buckets into projects. Clean structure that scales as you grow.
landing.feat2Body: Project-scoped keys. Revoke any key instantly without affecting the others.
landing.feat3Body: Serve files directly from the CDN. Temporary or permanent public links in one API call.
landing.feat4Body: Real-time events on uploads, renames and deletions. Built-in HMAC verification.
landing.feat5Body: Upload, browse, preview and manage files without writing a single line of code.
landing.feat6Body: Use AWS SDK, boto3, or any S3 tool. Zero vendor lock-in, works with your existing tooling.
landing.feat7Body: Presign flow to upload directly from mobile or browser, without going through your server.
landing.feat8Body: Files served from Cloudflare's global network. Low latency, everywhere.
landing.secureSubtitle: Build your product. We handle the security.
landing.secure1Body: Every key is tied to a single project. No global access, by design.
landing.secure2Body: SHA-256 signature on every webhook. Verify the authenticity of every event.
landing.secure3Body: Temporary access control for private files. Configurable expiration.
landing.secure4Body: Cloudflare R2 — distributed object storage, global high availability.
landing.secure5Body: Invalidate any API key in one click, without impacting others.
landing.secure6Body: Serve your public files with no outbound bandwidth costs.
landing.ctaBody: Free account. No credit card. Up and running in under 5 minutes.
landing.footerTagline: S3-compatible object storage for your apps and teams.

docs.title: Integration guide
docs.intro: NEXIUM Storage lets you upload, serve and manage files from any app via a simple REST API. Integrate in minutes — no AWS knowledge required.
docs.step1Body: Sign up at nexium.ai — free, no credit card required.
docs.step2Body: A project groups your buckets. A bucket holds your files.
docs.step3Body: Dashboard → API Keys → New key. Copy it immediately, shown only once.
docs.sdksIntro: The official SDKs wrap the REST API with typed methods and zero boilerplate. The JavaScript SDK has no runtime dependencies — it uses native <fetch>fetch</fetch> and <crypto>Web Crypto</crypto>. The Python SDK falls back to <urllib>urllib</urllib> when <requests>requests</requests> is not installed (file uploads require <requests>requests</requests>).
docs.sdksNote: The sections below document the raw REST API — useful if you're using Go, PHP, or any other language.
docs.authIntro: Pass your API key in the <auth>Authorization</auth> header on every request. All external API endpoints are prefixed with <ext>/api/v1/ext/</ext>. Store your key in an environment variable — never expose it in client-side code.
docs.authWarn: Your API key is scoped to a single project. Never commit it to git or include it in a frontend bundle.
docs.uploadIntro: Send a <mp>multipart/form-data</mp> POST with a <file>file</file> field. Replace <id><bucket_id></id> with your bucket's ID from the dashboard.
docs.listIntro: Returns all files in a bucket, ordered by most recent first. Pass an optional <search>?search=</search> query parameter to filter by filename.
docs.downloadIntro: Returns a permanent public URL. Use it directly in an <img> tag, Image.network() in Flutter, or any HTTP client — no expiration. If public access is not configured, a presigned URL valid 1 hour is returned instead.
docs.renameIntro: Updates the display name of a file. The object key in R2 is unchanged — only the <filename>filename</filename> field is updated.
docs.directIntro: For mobile apps (Flutter, React Native) or browser uploads, use the presign flow to upload directly to R2 — the file never passes through your server.
docs.presign1Body: Get a temporary upload URL and a file_id. Valid for 15 minutes.
docs.presign2Body: Upload the file directly to the returned upload_url. No auth header needed.
docs.presign3Body: Send the file_id, object_key and metadata to save the file record.
docs.deleteIntro: Permanently removes the file from storage and R2. Cannot be undone.
docs.errorsIntro: All errors return JSON with a <message>message</message> field.
docs.err400: Invalid input — check your request body or parameters
docs.err403: You don't have access to this resource
docs.err409: A bucket with this name already exists in this project
docs.err429: Rate limit exceeded — wait before retrying (Retry-After header provided)
docs.err500: Something went wrong on our end

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start for free. Scale at your own pace. No surprises.
pricing.faq1Q: Can I change plans at any time?
pricing.faq1A: Yes, you can upgrade to a higher plan at any time from your dashboard. The change is immediate.
pricing.faq2A: Yes, we use trusted mobile payment operators (Orange Money, Wave, etc.) with encrypted transactions.
pricing.faq3A: Add-ons are additional storage blocks you can purchase without changing your plan. Available from the Pro plan.
pricing.faq4A: No, all plans are commitment-free. You pay month by month and cancel whenever you want.
pricing.ctaBody: Create your free account and manage your files today.
